item: The tuning pass after a bulk import merges the search index in bounded, stoppable steps instead of one 'optimize'
refs: PR pending; import-speed plan; field restore measurements 2026-11-15
summary: Field measurement: the queue's post-run FTS5 'optimize' held the writer gate for more than 32 minutes and the post-import re-index could not start until it let go. merge_fts_segments runs a negative-count 'merge' (2000 pages a step), each step in its own short hold of the gate, until SQLite's own done signal (fewer than two rows changed), the queue's Stop, or OO_FTS_MERGE_BUDGET_S (default 300 s; 0 skips). Checked on a test index: the same single segment as 'optimize'. What is left stays correct and the next bulk pass carries on. optimize_after_bulk's fts flag still means fully merged.
